[[Tallov Kersk]]'s '''wife''' joined him in establishing a [[Farm/Legends|farm]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Muzara]]<ref name="RKD" />&mdash;in [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]].<ref name="CSWE II 346">{{CSWECite|II|346|Muzara}}</ref> The Kersks were joined by their son, [[Vettle]], Tallov's brother-in-law [[Karn (settler)|Karn]], his [[Karn's wife|wife]], and their daughter, [[Cavvie]]. The Kersk family became the first settlers from the [[Brentaal League]] to encounter the planet's native [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Muza]].<ref name="RKD" />
